title: Lions
content:
[[File:Johnston_De_Quadrupedibus_Loewe.jpg|thumb|400px|John Johnston]]
==Lion companions==
*[[Brothers of the Lion]] are an elite entourage that either win a lion companion or must live among the lion prides of the [[Devil's Fingers]]. 
*The [[Abbot of the Sainted Foot|Abbot of the Keepers of the Sainted Foot]] met with a hermit ([[09.01]]) whose cow ate his lion. The Abbot is a priest of [[Alberon]].
==Religion==
*The [[King in Splendour]] is considered by some a two-part god, with the other part being the Lion in Splendour
*[[Lion's Day]] is the summer solstice, named after the Lion in Splendour
*[[Lion priests]] are followers of the King in Splendour.
*Teodo is an iron lion statute, made to honour the King in Splendour ([[50.30]])

==Lion-like creatures==
*[[Saklas]] resemble lions sketched in the air by cords of fire. They can be tamed by blind lion priests.
*[[Draco-lions]] are mentioned in the [[Book of Not Being Boiled in Fire]]
*An [[alka-lions|alka-lion]] lives near the Temple of the Hunt ([[14.27]])
